tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: University charity event raising funds for a local animal shelter; asks friend Emma to volunteer. Write an email to Emma.
bullets: Describe the charity event and explain the type of support you need.
Ask if she would be willing to volunteer and specify the tasks she could assist with.
Explain how her help would benefit human members of the community as well as animals.
tasks.subject: Charity Event Volunteer Request
